title: recobbled
description: Tweaks the stonecutter to make switching block variants easier! Also adds a tuff recipe.
body:
This datapack aims to make changes to the stonecutter in order to make crafting blocks with it easier. For example, in vanilla Minecraft, putting any stair into a stonecutter does nothing. With recobbled, you can turn that stair into a different stair of the same block family (if applicable) or uncraft it back into the block it was made from. The goal of recobbled is to make using the stonecutter less of a pain, and to turn it into a very robust tool. Made too many of a certain block variant? Simply uncraft it, or turn it into different variants! Also allows for full blocks to be crafted with two slabs (except for a few blocks) and adds a recipe for tuff!

Is the description not doing it for you?
